bugs.name: The remote-browser editor is titled “Add a Remote Browser” even when editing an existing entry.
bugs.summary: The remote-browser editor is titled “Add a Remote Browser” even when editing an existing entry.
bugs.expected: The dialog heading should identify that an existing remote browser is being edited.
bugs.actual: The dialog heading says “Add a Remote Browser” while the existing entry's values are populated and the dialog includes a Delete button.
reproSteps: Open Settings > Remote Browsers and save a disposable remote browser with a name and WebSocket URL.
Click Edit on the saved entry.
Observe that the populated edit dialog is titled Add a Remote Browser.

bugs.name: Remote Browser Test bypasses required URL validation
bugs.summary: The Add Remote Browser dialog validates required fields when saving, but Test on a blank URL attempts a connection and displays an internal browserType.connect error.
bugs.expected: Test should validate that a URL is provided and prompt the user to fill it before attempting a connection.
bugs.actual: With both fields blank, clicking Test displayed an alert beginning “browserType.connect: Invalid URL” followed by Playwright connection logs. Clicking Save in the same blank dialog instead focused the required Friendly Name field.
reproSteps: Sign in as admin and open Settings > Remote Browsers.
Leave Friendly Name and URL blank, then click Test.
Observe an alert beginning “browserType.connect: Invalid URL” with connection logs rather than required-field validation.

bugs.name: Remote Browser deletion confirmation is missing “you” in its prompt
bugs.summary: The Remote Browser deletion confirmation omits you after Are you sure.
bugs.expected: The confirmation prompt should use grammatical copy, e.g. “Are you sure you want to delete this Remote Browser for all monitors?”
bugs.actual: The prompt reads “Are you sure want to delete this Remote Browser for all monitors?”, omitting “you” after “sure”.
reproSteps: Open Settings > Remote Browsers as the fixture administrator and add a disposable remote-browser entry.
Edit that entry and select Delete without confirming deletion.
Read Are you sure want to delete this Remote Browser for all monitors?.

bugs.name: Remote browser configuration saves an invalid URL
bugs.summary: Remote Browser Save persists a URL that Test rejects as syntactically invalid, creating an unusable remote browser configuration.
bugs.expected: Save rejects a syntactically invalid remote browser URL and requires a valid URL.
bugs.actual: Test reports 'browserType.connect: Invalid URL', but Save succeeds and creates the remote browser. Reopening confirms that 'not a url' was persisted.
reproSteps: Sign in and open Settings > Remote Browsers.
Enter a friendly name and enter not a url in the URL field.
Reopen the saved remote browser using Edit.
